scope: Intake V6 / ACM finish selection commercial pricing E2E trace (read-only)

findings.title: Commercial total does not change when operator selects a different, materially significant finish (face Oracal series/color, cant Oracal wrap, RAL paint)
findings.repro: 1) Open Intake V6 operator workspace, Step 2 Configurare, tab Finisaje. 2) Note 'Ofertă client' total. 3) Change face finish from any value to a different Oracal series (641/651/8500) and/or change cant finish to a different stock color, Oracal wrap, or RAL paint code. 4) Compare 'Ofertă client' total before/after.
findings.fixture: Live: workspace 5a5ce742-f50f-47b0-985b-32cc6f2fb6a4 (IV6-9C5D9538). API probe: synthetic held-constant geometry, TPL-VOLUMETRIC-LETTERS_v2, vector_file=test-bond-litere.svg (per Lead coordination fixture).
findings.expected: Total should change when switching among Oracal 641/651/8500 (internal material cost spread is 6.5/9.0/20.0 EUR/m2, a >3x difference) and when adding RAL paint (owner-documented 100 RON/color minimum) or Oracal cant wrap (owner-documented material+labor keys).
findings.actual: Total is identical (2.288,75 RON live; 577.50 RON in isolated API probe) across every face/cant finish variant tested. The commercial line 'finisaje_colantare_vopsire' always charges a flat 35 RON/m2 regardless of finish type or color.
findings.delta: 0.00 RON / 0.00 EUR in all 13 face+cant scenarios tested (A1-A6, B1-B7)
findings.root_owner: backend/data/commercial_rules_volumetric_v2.py — CommercialRuleDefinition for line_code='finisaje_colantare_vopsire' has quantity_paths keyed only on m2 area with no material_gate_path/material_gate_value branching on face_finish_type, face_oracal_code, return_finish_type, or return_oracal_code.
evidence: captures/D_mounting_material_control__D1_sablon_paper.json (positive control proving the material_gate_path mechanism works when authored)

findings.title: Internal cost model already knows finish materials differ by >3x but the commercial (customer-facing) price never reflects it — margin exposure
findings.repro: Compare intake_v4_oracal_face_pricing_service.py material rates (Oracal 641=6.5 EUR/m2, 651=9.0 EUR/m2, 8500=20.0 EUR/m2) and intake_v4_ral_paint_rules_service.py (RAL paint tube costing) against the CPP finisaje_colantare_vopsire line, which is flat regardless of which of these is selected.
findings.fixture: Code inspection + same API probe captures as F001
findings.field: EIC informational material breakdown vs. CommercialPriceProposal finish line
findings.expected: OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED on exact commercial markup policy, but at minimum the commercial price should not be provably insensitive to a documented >3x internal cost spread on a 'critical' pricing line.
findings.actual: EIC-side material differentiation exists and is computed correctly but is marked informational_only and is never consulted by CommercialPriceProposalService. A customer choosing the most expensive finish (Oracal 8500) is quoted the same total as a customer choosing the cheapest (Oracal 641) or no finish differentiation exists at all for cant Oracal/RAL.
findings.delta: Internal cost delta observed: 6.5 to 20.0 EUR/m2 (face material); commercial delta charged: 0.00 RON in all cases
findings.root_owner: Architectural separation between backend/services/intake_v4_oracal_face_pricing_service.py / intake_v4_ral_paint_rules_service.py (EIC, informational) and backend/data/commercial_rules_volumetric_v2.py (CPP, customer-facing) — no bridge exists and none is documented as forthcoming beyond the still-forbidden 'Product System' pricing activation.
evidence: frontend/src/features/product-system/canonicalFinishEnumMap.ts (owner-declared future pricing keys, not yet wired)

findings.title: ACM-only CommercialPriceProposal preview is unconditionally blocked by a geometry validator written for letter-oriented fields
findings.repro: POST /api/v1/product-system/commercial-price-preview/TPL-ACM-BOXED-MOUNTING-SUPPORT_v1 with valid ACM fields (panel_width_mm, panel_height_mm, acm_thickness_mm, return_depth_mm, fold_sides) and any shell_finish variant.
findings.expected: A structurally valid ACM panel payload should reach commercial rule evaluation (blocked or not on its own pricing merits), not be rejected purely on a geometry-shape mismatch.
findings.actual: All 4 ACM shell-finish scenarios tested return status=blocked, commercial_blockers=['CRITICAL_GEOMETRY_MISSING'], commercial_total=34.0 (a fixed pre-blocker line), identical regardless of shell finish — because the geometry validator expects letter_count-style fields not present (or not recognized) for a pure ACM template.
findings.delta: N/A — blocked before pricing rules execute
findings.root_owner: Geometry/quote_input validation layer feeding CommercialPriceProposalService for the ACM template — likely shared validation logic that assumes letter geometry.

findings.title: Finish type contract fields are unconstrained free-text strings; UI and backend/canonical token vocabularies silently diverge
findings.repro: Submit return_finish_type='mirror_silver' (a value not offered by the live UI combobox at all) to the CPP preview endpoint.
findings.expected: Either a validation error/warning for a value outside the live UI's actual option set, or documented confirmation that the wider vocabulary is intentionally supported server-side.
findings.actual: The field is declared as `str | None` with no Literal/Enum constraint. The value is silently accepted, status=ready, no warning referencing the unrecognized token. Separately, the live UI emits short tokens (white/black/gold/silver) while the schema default and canonical map use suffixed tokens (white_aluminum/black_aluminum/gold_aluminum) — no normalization layer was found bridging them.
findings.delta: N/A — contract/validation gap, not itself a price delta

findings.title: Component inclusion contradiction: layer shown 'Selected' while a system warning says the same layer is 'standby, not entering the quote'
findings.repro: Open workspace 5a5ce742-f50f-47b0-985b-32cc6f2fb6a4, Step 1 'Straturi'. Observe the 'Alucobond_s0020_Casetat' layer decision card (labeled Optional / Selectat) alongside the warning banner text.
findings.field: layer/component inclusion status vs. quote-scope warning text
findings.expected: A component's 'selected/included' status shown in one part of the UI should not contradict a simultaneous system warning about the same component's quote inclusion.
findings.actual: Component card shows 'Panou Alucobond casetat — Opțional · Selectat' while the warning banner reads: "Strat „Alucobond_s0020_Casetat" (ACM/casetat) — standby, nu intră în quote litere volumetrice." (Layer — standby, does not enter the volumetric letters quote.)
findings.delta: Not measured — discovered incidentally, outside primary finish-pricing scope; flagged for its own investigation.
findings.root_owner: Unclear from this audit — likely a layer-role vs. component-confirmation state synchronization gap in the Intake V6 Step-1 'Straturi' UI/PD binding.
findings.code_path: Not traced in this audit (out of finish-pricing scope) — recommend a dedicated follow-up.

findings.title: Owner-drafted 'Product System' component-ownership decision already anticipates distinct pricing keys for cant Oracal wrap and RAL paint (including a 100 RON/color minimum) — none of it is wired into the live CPP
findings.repro: Compare frontend/src/features/product-system/canonicalFinishEnumMap.ts entries cant_oracal_wrap / cant_ral_paint / cant_ral_minimum_policy against backend/data/commercial_rules_volumetric_v2.py.
findings.expected: N/A — this finding reclassifies F001's cant-side rows from 'silent unknown gap' to 'known/anticipated missing rule', since a specific commercial policy (100 lei/RAL color) is already owner-documented.
findings.actual: commercial_rules_volumetric_v2.py has no rule referencing MAT-ORACAL-641/651, MAT-VOPSEA-RAL-CANT-*, RETURN_CANT_VINYL_APPLICATION_LABOR, RETURN_CANT_RAL_PAINT_LABOR, or a 100 RON RAL minimum. Note: the owner-decision doc explicitly disclaims 'Pricing activation from Product System contracts' as still-forbidden as of its date, and describes a separate future architecture — this finding is corroborating context, not a claim that the doc itself mandates immediate CPP wiring.
findings.root_owner: Product/architecture sequencing — Product System canonical map (future) vs. live Intake V6 CPP (present) are two different systems that both use the word 'finish'.

findings.title: "Unconfirmed finish groups" warning implies deferred/gated pricing, but confirmed=true/false/empty/absent all produce the same ready status and same numeric total
findings.repro: Submit letter_group_finishes with confirmed=true, confirmed=false, an empty list, and an absent (None) field, holding all else constant.
findings.expected: If the warning text 'may require owner review before numeric pricing' is accurate, an unconfirmed/empty/absent state should differ from a confirmed state (e.g., status=blocked, owner_decision_required=true, or a different total).
findings.actual: All four states return status=ready and commercial_total=577.50, identical to the confirmed=true baseline. Only the warning list changes slightly (extra text for empty/absent), never the numeric outcome.
findings.root_owner: backend/services/commercial_price_proposal_service.py — warning generation is decoupled from actual gating logic for the finisaje line.

findings.title: Stock cant colors (Alb/Negru/Auriu/Argintiu) zero-delta is correct-by-design — documented for completeness, not a defect
findings.repro: Switch return_finish_type among white/black/gold/silver, all else constant.
findings.fixture: API probe scenarios B1-B3 (+ B baseline)
findings.expected: Zero delta, per owner documentation (no additional finish tariff for stock colors).
findings.actual: Zero delta observed, matching the documented expectation exactly.

findings.title: Mounting-template material control group confirms the material-gated differential pricing mechanism exists and works correctly elsewhere in the same rule table
findings.repro: Switch mounting_template_material_type between paper and forex, all else constant.
findings.expected: Total should differ per the distinct sablon_montaj_hartie (5 EUR/m2) vs sablon_montaj_forex (15 RON/m2 dev bridge) rules, each gated by material_gate_path/material_gate_value.
findings.actual: Total correctly differs: 582.50 RON (paper) vs 592.50 RON (forex), a +10.00 RON delta, matching the two distinct rule definitions exactly.
findings.root_owner: N/A — confirmed correct behavior; used as positive control / root-cause corroboration for F001 (proves the missing mechanism in finisaje_colantare_vopsire is an authoring gap, not a framework limitation)

test_run_summary.note: Read-only report per Lead instructions. No tests weakened or modified. Pre-existing failures categorized below are NOT caused by this audit (all probe traffic used the read-only /commercial-price-preview endpoint; no DB writes).

groups.error_cause: Pre-existing test-DB schema drift: sqlite3.OperationalError: no such column: product_templates.publication_status (missing migration in test fixtures) — all 6 errors are this same root cause, in tests/test_commercial_price_proposal_site_installation_binding.py.

11 errors: same product_templates.publication_status schema drift. 5 failures: test-infra issues (404 Not Found on endpoints under test, missing optional module 'svgpathtools') unrelated to finish-pricing logic.

Mock/fixture drift: 'FakeDb' object has no attribute 'execute'; QuoteOutputCompositionService missing attribute '_latest_quote_snapshot_v2' (internal rename not reflected in test mocks); assorted 404s and one status-string assertion mismatch ('ready' vs 'blocked'). Pre-existing test-infrastructure debt, not newly introduced.

return_to_lead.commercial_integrity_blocked_reason: The live Intake V6 -> CommercialPriceProposal path generates real 'Ofertă client' totals feeding the 'Creaza oferta pretuita' action, and this total is proven (live UI + 17 API probe scenarios) to be insensitive to face/cant finish selection for Oracal series, Oracal colors, and RAL paint, despite the business already owning documented internal cost differentiation (>3x) and a specific RAL commercial minimum policy (100 RON/color) that is simply not implemented in the live pricing rule table.
top_root_owners: backend/data/commercial_rules_volumetric_v2.py (finisaje_colantare_vopsire rule — single flat rate, no material_gate_path branching)
Disconnect between EIC informational cost services (intake_v4_oracal_face_pricing_service.py, intake_v4_ral_paint_rules_service.py) and CommercialPriceProposalService
ACM commercial-preview geometry validator (rejects valid ACM-only payloads with CRITICAL_GEOMETRY_MISSING)
schemas/intake_v4.py finish-type fields (unconstrained str, no enum contract)
